summary: Frontend-only testing of iter41 security features (Security page with idle window selector, Change Password strength meter, SessionWarning wiring). Logged in as advisor@compass.ca via email/password + TOTP MFA. All critical flows passed. Advisor password left at 'Compass2026!' and idle window restored to 15 minutes as required.
critical_code_review_comments: SecuritySettings idle fallback uses 15 if q.data undefined — fine, but UI briefly shows '15 minutes' as current before query resolves (acceptable).

ChangePasswordModal strength calculation is slightly odd: it caps 'strength' to STRENGTH[2] (Fair) when !strong, which means some mid-strength passwords never visually show 'Good'/'Strong' until they also pass category check. Works correctly for the test cases ('abc'->Too weak, 'NewStrong123!'/'TempStrong123!'->Strong).
useIdleLogout cleanly ignores activity during the warning window — this matches the stated UX requirement.
verified_scenarios: Security nav item (nav-security) under Governance group loads /security page (security-page visible).
idle-current initial value = '15 minutes'; idle-option-30 click -> 'Security settings saved' toast + idle-current = '30 minutes'; idle-option-15 click restores to '15 minutes'.
Change Password modal opens from security-change-password; typing weak 'abc' into cp-new shows pw-strength + label 'Too weak' and cp-submit stays DISABLED.
With current='Compass2026!' + new/confirm='NewStrong123!' the pw-strength-label becomes 'Strong' and cp-submit is ENABLED.

Submitting current='Compass2026!' new/confirm='TempStrong123!' produced 'Password updated' toast and modal closed; immediate revert (current='TempStrong123!' new/confirm='Compass2026!') succeeded — password left at Compass2026!.
No session-warning-modal rendered during normal navigation; no page errors or exceptions from useIdleLogout/SessionWarningModal. Only two benign 401s on initial /auth/me probe before token hydration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Advisor account is CLEAN: password=Compass2026!, idle_minutes=15. Do not test firmadmin change-password (rate-limited). TOTP shared secret JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP works for all demo accounts. Login flow is 3-step: email+pwd -> Continue -> TOTP input -> Verify.
